The '''''Vehemence''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''Vehemence'' was [[Battle of the Vehemence|attacked]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces, sustaining [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] fire to its [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]].
